measure_proto_comment_lines: // Tax amortised cost, per 100 face, quantity-weighted over the open lots
// (LM-364; implemented under VS-110). See docs/adr/amortisation_elections.md.
// Inputs: cost_basis (CostBasisInput) on BondInput, TipsInput or FrnInput:
//   lots, the holding's open TaxLotProto lots, and elections, the
//   portfolio's AmortisationElectionsProto (unset = every default).
// Formula, for each open lot i:
//   acb_i = the lot's amortised cost per 100 face at the valuation date:
//           price_i, adjusted by the OID, premium and market-discount rules below.
//   AdjustedCostBasis = sum(open_quantity_i * acb_i) / sum(open_quantity_i)
// OID: always accreted (mandatory, whatever the elections) at constant yield
//   from the issue price (IssuanceProto.price_for_single_price_auction,
//   MDI-82), reduced by any acquisition premium.
// Premium (IRC §171): amortised at constant yield if elected
//   (bond_premium; the default is PREMIUM_ELECTED).
// Market discount: accreted only with INCLUDE_CURRENTLY, ratably or at
//   constant yield per market_discount_accrual (the default is RATABLE);
//   otherwise (AT_DISPOSITION, the default) left until disposition.
// De minimis: OID and market discount below 0.25% × complete years to
//   maturity are treated as zero.
// Accrual start: from each lot's open_date plus the product's settlement lag
//   (e.g. T+1 for Treasuries).
// TIPS: amortise in real terms, then multiply by the index ratio
//   (INDEX_RATIO) at the valuation date, giving a figure per 100 original
//   face in nominal dollars:
//     AdjustedCostBasis = sum(open_quantity_i * real_acb_i) / sum(open_quantity_i)
//                         * IndexRatio(valuation date)
//   real_acb_i: lot i's amortised cost per 100 real face. It starts from the
//     lot's real purchase price (TaxLotProto.price) and accrues at constant
//     yield on real principal.
//   open_quantity_i: the lot's original (unadjusted) face.
//   Accrual start: as above, on real principal. valuation-service owns the
//     settlement lag; lots carry no settlement field.
//   Elections: premium and market discount accrue or not per the elections,
//     as in the fixed-rate rules above.
//   IndexRatio(valuation date): INDEX_RATIO for the UTC date of
//     ValuationRequestProto.asof_datetime. It uses only the m-3 and m-2
//     readings in TipsInput.cpi. Lot dates need no CPI readings.
//   Rounding: none. real_acb_i, the weighted average, the index ratio and
//     the result are all unrounded, as for INDEX_RATIO and MARKET_VALUE.
//   Deflation floor: not applied. It applies only to final principal
//     (INFLATION_ADJUSTED_PRINCIPAL), never to the basis.
//   Example: lots of 10000 at real_acb 99.00 and 5000 at 101.50, index
// FRN: use the equivalent fixed rate from the fixing at settlement.
// No lots: the measure is absent, with a "no open lots" warning, never 0.
// Scope: tax basis only. Book (GAAP/IFRS) cost is out of scope.
// Applicability: TREASURY_NOTE, TREASURY_BOND, SOVEREIGN_BOND, CORP_BOND,
//   MUNI_BOND, TIPS, TREASURY_FRN.
// Units: Price per 100 face (% of par). TIPS: per 100 original face, in
//   nominal dollars.
ADJUSTED_COST_BASIS = 4;

catalog.description: Tax amortised cost, per 100 face, quantity-weighted over the open lots. Tax basis only; book (GAAP/IFRS) cost is out of scope. Inputs: cost_basis (CostBasisInput) on BondInput, TipsInput or FrnInput.
catalog.formula: AdjustedCostBasis = sum(open_quantity_i * acb_i) / sum(open_quantity_i) over CostBasisInput.lots, where acb_i is lot i's amortised cost per 100 face at the valuation date. OID: always accreted (mandatory, whatever the elections) at constant yield from the issue price (IssuanceProto.price_for_single_price_auction, MDI-82), reduced by any acquisition premium. Premium (IRC §171): amortised at constant yield if elected. Market discount: accreted only with INCLUDE_CURRENTLY, ratably or at constant yield per market_discount_accrual; otherwise left until disposition. De minimis: OID and market discount below 0.25% × complete years to maturity are treated as zero. TIPS: AdjustedCostBasis = sum(open_quantity_i * real_acb_i) / sum(open_quantity_i) * IndexRatio(valuation date), where real_acb_i is lot i's amortised cost per 100 real face: it starts from the lot's real purchase price (TaxLotProto.price) and accrues at constant yield on real principal; open_quantity_i is the lot's original (unadjusted) face; and IndexRatio(valuation date) is INDEX_RATIO for the UTC date of ValuationRequestProto.asof_datetime. Example: lots of 10000 at real_acb 99.00 and 5000 at 101.50, index ratio 1.2 -> (10000*99.00 + 5000*101.50) / 15000 * 1.2 = 119.80.
catalog.units: Price per 100 face (% of par). TIPS: per 100 original face, in nominal dollars
model_assumptions: Accrual start: from each lot's open_date plus the product's settlement lag (e.g. T+1 for Treasuries)
Elections: CostBasisInput.elections, copied from PortfolioProto.amortisation_elections; unset fields use the defaults (PREMIUM_ELECTED, AT_DISPOSITION, RATABLE)
TIPS: amortise in real terms, then multiply by the index ratio at the valuation date, giving a figure per 100 original face in nominal dollars
TIPS accrual start: from each lot's open_date plus the product's settlement lag, on real principal; valuation-service owns the settlement lag and lots carry no settlement field
TIPS elections: premium and market discount accrue or not per the elections, as in the fixed-rate rules
TIPS CPI: only the m-3 and m-2 readings for the valuation date in TipsInput.cpi; lot dates need no CPI readings
TIPS rounding: none. real_acb_i, the weighted average, the index ratio and the result are all unrounded, as for INDEX_RATIO and MARKET_VALUE
TIPS deflation floor: not applied. It applies only to final principal (INFLATION_ADJUSTED_PRINCIPAL), never to the basis
FRN: use the equivalent fixed rate from the fixing at settlement
No lots: the measure is absent, with a "no open lots" warning, never 0
